Motion Graphics media tools

FFmpeg and FFprobe are separate executables, distributed without modification.
They run locally to decode media, generate previews, and prepare AE-compatible files.

FFmpeg 6.1.1 essentials Windows x64, Gyan build (via ffmpeg-static npm package).
Exact FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/e38092ef93
Build project and dependency/build information: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
See ffmpeg-build-README.txt and COPYING-GPLv3.txt.

FFprobe Windows x64, Gyan build 20230213-2296078
Distributed via @ffprobe-installer/win32-x64 5.1.0 (npm).
Exact FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/2296078
Build project: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
See ffprobe-package.json and COPYING-GPLv3.txt.

FFmpeg project: https://ffmpeg.org/
Upstream package distribution: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ffmpeg-static
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ffprobe-installer/win32-x64

These components retain their GPL v3 licenses. Keep these notices and the
corresponding source/build references with redistributed packages.
